subject: Learning Methods
title: Exercise and Sleep
description: A 60-second lesson on Exercise and Sleep.

hook.text: Regular exercisers fall asleep 55 % faster and sleep 42 minutes longer than non-exercisers.

buildup.text: Exercise increases deep sleep duration. More deep sleep means more memory consolidation and better learning retention.

discovery.text: Exercise and Sleep reveals the principle that makes the learning stick.

twist.text: Exercising within two hours of bedtime can delay sleep onset. The body needs time to cool down.

climax.text: Add 30 minutes of moderate exercise to your day, finishing at least two hours before bed.

punchline.text: Exercise for sleep. Sleep for learning. The cycle connects.

quiz.question: How does exercise improve sleep quality?
options: It exhausts muscles so the body has no choice but to sleep
It increases deep sleep duration and triggers a cool-down signal for the brain
Exercise releases melatonin directly into the bloodstream
